svg.title: How Tandem works
svg.desc: Your Flutter screen lists what the agent gets: .sees(draft), data the agent reads; .calls(setQuantity), methods it may call; .callsWithApproval(placeOrder), calls that wait for the user; and TandemView, views from your widgets. TandemScope connects the screen to tandem, between your screen and the agent. Tandem sends only the listed data, runs only the listed methods, waits for the user's approval and checks every view before it shows. Any agent connects to tandem: TandemBridge, your coding agent; AG-UI, your agent backend; Firebase AI Logic, Gemini, without a backend.
